text:
Sarah T.: quick question — re: integrator lead staking window and SLA exception flows. current behavior blocks claims when account has an owner. how do we want to treat 'exception' leads where multiple SI partners are legitimately engaged?

Dan P.: +1 to discuss. we keep hitting cases where SI B surfaces a pipeline but SI A already owns account; currently we deny claim and nothing happens for days. propose a 'stake' concept: 24h non-exclusive stake that pauses automated outreach and notifies partnerships for adjudication.

Alisha R.: i like the stake idea. clarifying Q: during stake does owner still have action rights (e.g., can do discovery)? or is it a soft hold that prevents new opportunity creation?

Dan P.: soft hold — owner can continue existing opportunities but cannot create new committed pipeline entries for the same opportunity id until stake resolves. intent is to avoid churn while we decide.

Kevin M.: one operational detail: we need a Claim TTL and a Stake TTL. current claim TTL = 72h. suggestion: change to Claim TTL = 48h, Stake TTL = 24h. also add an "escalate" flag when stake expires without resolution.

Sarah T.: here's a rough flow i sketched:
```
on_claim_attempt(account, claimor):
  if account.owner == null:
    assign_owner(claimor)
  elif account.owner == claimor:
    refresh_claim_TTL(claimor)
  else:
    create_stake_record(claimor, TTL=24h)
    notify_partnerships_channel(account, claimor, owner)
```

Alisha R.: perfect. what about outreach gating? can we add a simple check in SFDC webhook that prevents "new outbound cadence" events if a stake exists?

Dan P.: yes — we'll add a small guard in the automation service, same place we block duplicate cadences today. i can add a feature flag while we test.

launch-bot: created ticket PART-4821: "Stake workflow + outreach gating for integrator claims" assigned to @Dan P.

Kevin M.: also propose an "escalation anchor" owner in the partnerships team for multi-SI disputes. default to Partnerships GTM lead in account's region after stake TTL. this avoids fractional ownership limbo.

Sarah T.: good call. can we also auto-attach the last 3 interactions and the pipeline snapshot to the ticket? makes adjudication faster.

Dan P.: yep — will include a small payload: last_3_emails, active_opps_snapshot, claimed_by_history.

Alisha R.: timeline? i'd like to pilot in EMEA first (smaller partner set).

Dan P.: planned rollout: dev -> internal QA -> pilot in EMEA (2 weeks) -> roll to NA if clean. i'll open a short RFC doc in confluence and drop link here when ready.

Sarah T.: thanks everyone. can folks react with :thumbsup: if they approve the stake TTL and outreach gating plan? we'll treat 72h->48h claim TTL decision as tentative until RFC is live.

Kevin M.: :thumbsup:

Alisha R.: :thumbsup:

Dan P.: :thumbsup: will post RFC link shortly.

Sarah T.: filing notes in the partnership ops board. ping me if you want to be on the pilot.

(End of thread)
